fails_if: the SOS reader fills a delivered blank Data till from the register or subset period (open or closed), backfills a blank Data från from an open period, reads a malformed end as an open bound, or widens an explicit end to the open period
note: The replaced test read the open context and a closed enclosing subset as separate workbooks; one workbook carries both, PAR_SV standing in for the closed subset.

projections.note: Blank end, open register and open subset: still the row's own open end.
Blank end in a closed subset: the subset's 2020 is not copied in.
An explicit end is not widened by the open context.
A blank start is not backfilled from the open context.
A malformed end is not read as an open bound.
